Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.util.image.capture

Class DirectRobotCapture

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.util.image.capture.DirectRobotCapture
@Component public class DirectRobotCapture extends Object
Direct screen capture using SikuliX Screen API. This ensures proper Brobot-compliant screen capture without using Robot.

This class wraps SikuliX screen capture functionality to provide direct screen capture without additional transformations.

Since:
1.1.0

    • captureRegion

      public BufferedImage captureRegion(int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Captures a screen region using SikuliX Screen API. NO additional scaling, NO DPI adjustments, NO transformations.
      Parameters:
      x - X coordinate in actual screen pixels
      y - Y coordinate in actual screen pixels
      width - Width in actual screen pixels
      height - Height in actual screen pixels
      Returns:
      Raw captured image at actual pixel resolution

    • compareWithSikuliCapture

      public void compareWithSikuliCapture(BufferedImage sikuliCapture, int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Compares direct Robot capture with SikuliX capture. Useful for debugging scaling issues.
      Parameters:
      sikuliCapture - Image captured by SikuliX
      x - X coordinate
      y - Y coordinate
      width - Width
      height - Height
